free_tier.stated: USD 5 a month flat, prorated, for 250 GB of storage and 1 TB of outbound transfer added to the account's transfer pool; storage beyond 250 GB USD 0.02 per GB a month

per_object_cap.stated: 5 TiB per object; a single upload is at most 5 GB, larger objects by multipart upload of up to 10,000 parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB
per_object_cap.notes: Maximum Object Size under the multipart upload limits of the first-party quotas and limits page

egress.terms: enabling Object Storage adds 1 TB a month of transfer allowance, prorated by active hours, to the account's global network transfer pool and none to region-specific pools such as Jakarta and São Paulo; all outbound transfer from Object Storage is metered, over public IPv4 and IPv6, even to other services in the same data center; inbound transfer is free; transfer beyond the pools is billed at the end of the billing period at the rate of the service region
egress.price_per_tb: USD 0.005 per GB (about USD 5 per TB) beyond the pool; USD 0.015 per GB in Jakarta and USD 0.007 per GB in São Paulo

record.tooling: S3 API, rclone s3 backend, any SDK. Cluster URL per region. The endpoint type (E0 to E3) is a property of the region and its endpoint hostname, chosen when a bucket is created, and is not an account-level default; most regions offer one type and a few offer several; new customers are directed to the standard E2 or E3 endpoints, and Limited Availability endpoints are opened by a support ticket.
record.chaining: The 1 TB/month included egress is the free slice: enough for 33 GB/day, matching Gcore. Its real use is as a stable S3 origin behind one of the free CDNs, not as the delivery path. $5/TB egress is good but Bunny's Volume tier matches it and CacheFly/Telnyx beat it.

limits.value: 750 requests/s per bucket for all operations on E0 and E1 endpoints; on E2 and E3 by default 2,000 GET/HEAD, 500 PUT, 100 LIST and 200 DELETE requests/s per bucket; requests above the limit get HTTP 503
default capacity per account per endpoint 5 TB on E0, 100 TB on E1 and E2, 500 TB on E3; per bucket at most 1 TB on E0, 1 PB on E1 and E2, 5 PB on E3

record.limits_note: 5 GB per single upload; multipart parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB, up to 10,000 parts; 1,000 buckets per account per endpoint by default; default ingress and egress throughput 2 Gbps per account per endpoint on E0 and E1 and 10 Gbps on E2 and E3; on E0 and E1 delete requests are capped at 100 per second per bucket within the 750 requests/s limit; quotas are account defaults, while product limits cannot be increased

identity_cost.detail: a valid credit card on file is a requirement of the Master Services Agreement; Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover are accepted, and credit can be added from a PayPal account
